## [Unreleased](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/compare/v1.5.0...main)

**Changes since the latest release**

Follow the work on main before the next version is tagged.

### Added

- English and Spanish Markdown histories generated from the same source as the website.
- Changelog links in the landing, documentation, quality pages and README, with localized metadata and sitemap entries.

## [1.5.0](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/releases/tag/v1.5.0) — 2026-10-20

**Your connected workspace**

65 frontend integration recipes, a shared hub and practical workflows for connected SaaS products.

### Added

- 17 workflow families and 86 provider choices covering data, identity, commerce, files, email, analytics, notifications, jobs, collaboration, editors, search, maps, AI, knowledge, agents, product connectors and automation.
- AI streaming, reviewed tool calls, routing and fallback diagnostics, knowledge-source management and agent progress.
- Injectable IntegrationSuite adapters, HTTP transports and optional editor, map, Picker, media, enterprise, realtime and command-search bindings.
- A public quality page, version-scoped Lighthouse reports, sponsorship links and bilingual integration research.

### Improved

- The catalogue now includes 135 views, 127 source registry entries and 24 documentation chapters.
- Connection workflows support cancellation, revision checks, reviewed requests and idempotent retries at the consumer boundary.

### Verified

- 865 passing unit tests, strict component and integration examples, and 317 local provider/action bindings.
- Browser acceptance covers 290 scenarios for each root and mounted host through recorded cohorts and focused reruns; the QA receipt preserves the exact scope.

The public demo uses local mocks. Consumers supply their backend, accounts and credentials. Native Figma and Lighthouse evidence retains its original version and scope.

[QA receipt](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/blob/v1.5.0/docs/qa-runtime-1.5.0.json) · [Provider coverage](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/blob/v1.5.0/docs/integrations/provider-coverage.json) · [Compare changes](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/compare/v1.4.1...v1.5.0)

## [1.4.1](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/releases/tag/v1.4.1) — 2026-10-20

**A new home for the kit**

The public website and complete documentation arrive on aureformui.com, hosted on Cloudflare.

### Added

- An editorial landing with real product previews, six palettes, light/dark themes, gradients and GSAP/Lenis motion.
- 22 documentation chapters with heading search, mobile navigation and code copy; 19 chapters have English/Spanish sources and three retain their original language explicitly.
- Localized metadata, canonical URLs, reciprocal language links, sitemap, robots, structured data and a social sharing image.

### Improved

- Marketing and documentation load separately from the application demo. GitHub Pages remains available as a backup.
- Cloudflare deployment automation and SHA-256 verification for the public source download.

### Verified

- 244 unit tests, 46 root browser scenarios, 37 mounted browser scenarios and successful static exports.

Historical QA numbers describe this release only. Its documentation and design evidence keep their recorded language and version boundaries.

[QA receipt](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/blob/v1.4.1/docs/qa-runtime-1.4.1.json) · [Compare changes](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1)

## [1.4.0](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/releases/tag/v1.4.0) — 2026-10-19

**Commerce, maps and access**

Richer application workflows for products, orders, invoices, billing, maps and authentication.

### Added

- A product editor with prices, currency, stock and image upload, crop, rotation, alt text, ordering and live preview.
- Connected mock orders, stock updates, invoice creation and export, payment retries, plans and a customer portal preview.
- Typed Stripe transport contracts and optional Google Maps with a restricted browser key, local layers and GeoJSON export.
- Discoverable sign-in, registration, recovery and verification screens, plus replaceable Google, GitHub and Microsoft mock callbacks.

### Improved

- 107 source registry entries, bilingual application integration guides and updated application screenshots.

### Verified

- 244 unit tests, 92 full-suite browser tests and a separate set of 18 final mounted application tests.

Payments and social access remain mock in the public demo. Real Stripe endpoints, webhooks, OAuth sessions and Google configuration belong to the consuming application.

[Application contracts](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/blob/v1.4.0/docs/application-integrations.md) · [Compare changes](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0)

## [1.3.0](https://github.com/terrizoaguimor/aureform-ui/releases/tag/v1.3.0) — 2026-10-19

**Open source, for everyone**

The first public GitHub release opens the Aureform kit, source, design resources and original images under Apache 2.0.

### Added

- 69 views, 44 core component families and 96 source registry entries for dashboards, SaaS workspaces and internal tools.
- Six palettes, light/dark themes, gradients, shades, hover treatments and an appearance studio with JSON, CSS and React exports.
- GSAP entrances, optional Lenis scrolling, reduced-motion support, customer operations, CSV imports, workspace/team flows and bilingual examples.
- 32 original generated images, an editable Figma companion, SVG exports, shared tokens, local Code Connect templates and scoped native evidence.

### Verified

- 189 unit tests and 74 end-to-end tests passed; all 69 views were exercised in both languages under the Pages base path.

Original Aureform resources use Apache 2.0; upstream licenses remain in place. The design bundle documents its available formats and does not claim a native .fig export.
